Beware of these Identity Security Horrors
The Treat: Zluri connects with your HR and IdP systems and auto-revokes access on the day of their exit
The Trick: Attackers exploit abandoned credentials from / ex-employees to breach systems undetected
The Treat: Zluri tracks usage patterns across 30/60/90-day windows to find and remove dormant accounts
The Trick: Inactive accounts are low-effort targets for credential theft with zero monitoring
The Treat: Zluri tracks 100% of your tech stack and sends alerts whenever someone uses restricted tools
The Trick: Teams enter sensitive data into unapproved apps without IT knowing
The Treat: Zluri finds all service accounts, shows who owns them, and identifies those with overpermissive access to ens
The Trick: Service accounts that run with excessive privileges are rarely monitored, making them vulnerable to persisten
The Treat: Zluri finds apps with overlapping features, helping you optimize your spend
The Trick: Different teams buy similar tools to do the same job, so you're paying twice for duplicate apps
The Treat: Zluri sets time-bound access with automatic access expiration aligned with project timelines
The Trick: Contractors can still access your systems after their project ends and can leak confidential data
